name: Dinosaur Puzzles
summary:
Enjoy a set of three high-quality zero gravity Jigsaw Puzzles that you can play from the comfort of your home or anywhere you want in full Mixed Reality featuring beautiful dinosaurs.

Each 100+ piece puzzle can be played with hand tracking or controllers, and can be saved to build across multiple sessions. Great for new and existing VR players of all ages from 10-100 and beyond.
